title: Influence of a thin insole on the biomechanics of the footballer
summary: The aim of the study is therefore to investigate whether individualized, foot-shape–dependent insoles produce measurable changes in the temporal organization of muscle activation and in biomechanical movement parameters during dynamic sporting movement tasks.

interventions.name: In this study, it will be examined whether an insole affects kinematics, kinetics, muscle activity, or plantar pressure. criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- No injuries or surgeries of the lower extremities in the last 6 months; no acute systemic infections
- BMI < 25
- No cardiovascular or cardiopulmonary pre-existing conditions
- Sporting experience: at least 2 years of active participation in training and match play for a football club of any league level
Exclusion criteria:
- Injuries and/or surgical procedures to the lower extremities within the last 6 months prior to study participation
- Pregnancy
- Acute systemic infections
